subject: Coord: demo timing vs FY budget reset (need to shift)
messages:
From: Claire Hahn <claire.hahn@oldmillhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivas <tom.rivas@oldmillhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@oldmillhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week?

Thanks for the invite, Sean. The team is excited to see a walkthrough, but a heads up: our CFO is heading overseas next week and Finance just flagged a short FY budget reset window starting 11/19. Procurement is likely to pause new purchases until the budget refresh completes.

Can we pause the full technical demo until Finance confirms the purchase timeline? If possible we could still do a short 20-minute executive ridealong next Tuesday (11/17) to keep momentum for the leadership team, but any deep technical session or pricing discussion should probably wait until we have clarity post-budget.

If helpful, loop in Procurement and I can try to get a note on their calendar for the week after Thanksgiving when they expect to reconvene (tentatively the week of 11/30).

—Claire
Claire Hahn
Head of Platforms, OldMill Health
claire.hahn@oldmillhealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hahn <claire.hahn@oldmillhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week?

Claire — really appreciate the heads up and totally makes sense to avoid putting Procurement in a tough spot during the FY reset. Two quick asks:

1) If a short exec ridealong (20m) on 11/17 keeps leadership engaged, we can do that — Marissa can run a very targeted value summary and show the ROI dashboard.
2) For the deep technical walkthrough and pricing review, would you prefer we tentatively propose the week of 11/30 or the following week? We can also prepare a compact "PO-readiness" packet for Procurement so the first conversation after the freeze is focused and efficient.

I've attached a one-pager and the pricing estimate we planned to discuss; Marissa, Neha — can you confirm availability for a short slot on 11/17 and a few options in the 11/30–12/07 window?

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda), pricing-estimate-RDW-9345.xlsx (estimate)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Claire Hahn <claire.hahn@oldmillhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week?

Sean / Claire — 11/17 short slot works for me: I can do 11/17 at 11:00am PT (20 minutes) and will keep it executive-focused: one slide on TL;DR value, one slide on cost controls (batching/quantization levers), and a quick Q&A.

For the technical deep-dive, here are the windows we can offer:
- Tue 11/30 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred; our infra lead will be available)
- Wed 12/01 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 12/03 09:00–10:30 PT (narrow slot)

Neha, please confirm if you can join the 11/30 session for procurement readiness — we want to walk the PO checklist, contract cadence, and SSO/KMS notes so Procurement has what they need first thing after the freeze.

Claire — if Procurement prefers a different cadence, we can adapt. Also happy to record the technical walk for internal review so the vendors team can watch asynchronously.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Claire Hahn <claire.hahn@oldmillhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivas <tom.rivas@oldmillhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@oldmillhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro demo next week?

Thanks, everyone — confirmed internally: the CFO travel extends a bit and Finance locked the refresh until 11/29. Procurement asked to avoid gating their calendar this week. That said, leadership still wants a brief touchpoint to stay synced.

We will take the 11/17 11:00am PT executive ridealong (Claire + Tom). For the technical + procurement session, Procurement asked for the week of 11/30; they prefer Tue 11/30 10:00am PT if that slot still works for you. If not, Wed 12/01 13:00 PT is acceptable.

Tom will loop Procurement directly if anything shifts. Please send the short slide deck for the exec meeting and a PO-readiness checklist before the 11/30 session so Procurement can review over the weekend.

—Claire
